name: File Canary (FIM)
description: Honeypot and File Integrity Monitor. Watches files/directories for unauthorized modifications.

documentation.summary: The File Canary acts as both a Honeypot and a File Integrity Monitor (FIM). It watches a specified directory or file on the host machine for unauthorized access, modifications, or encryption attempts (e.g., Ransomware spreading across the LAN).

sections.title: Features
content: Plausible Lures: Newly created decoy files get realistic but entirely fabricated content (config, SQL dump, VPN key) chosen by file name; existing files are never modified.
Read and Tamper Detection: Alerts on open/read (default on) and on modification, attribute change, deletion or move.
Burst Collapsing: Repeated identical events within the cooldown are reported once.

sections.title: Security Architecture
content: Global Sandbox Baseline: Enforced by the TrueSignal Hub. Drops ALL Linux capabilities, enforces a read-only filesystem and no-new-privileges, and applies log rotation.
Execution Privilege: The monitor runs unprivileged as UID 65532 with read-only binds of the lure files only.
Provisioning: A one-shot init container (UID 0, DAC_OVERRIDE only, no network) creates missing lure files in their parent directories.
Attribution: inotify reports what happened to a lure, not which process did it; correlate the timestamp with EDR telemetry for the actor.

heuristics.recommendation_reason: Application runtime detected. Deploying a file integrity monitor is highly recommended to catch suspicious canary file interactions or ransomware activity.

env_vars.name: TS_HUB_ENDPOINT
env_vars.description: The URL of your central TrueSignal Hub.

env_vars.name: TS_SENSOR_ID
env_vars.description: Unique identifier for this specific trap.

env_vars.name: TS_SEVERITY
env_vars.description: Alert severity sent to the Hub.

env_vars.name: TS_ALERT_ON_OPEN
env_vars.description: Alert when a lure is opened or read. Reading a lure is the core deception signal; disable only if a legitimate process (backup, AV) must read the paths.

env_vars.name: TS_DECOY_FILES
env_vars.description: Comma-separated list of absolute file paths to deploy and monitor.
env_vars.default: {{ if .HasWeb }}/var/www/html/.backup-config.php{{ else if .HasDB }}/var/lib/db/dump.sql.bak{{ else }}/opt/.env.backup{{ end }}{{ if gt (len .MatchedServices) 1 }},/home/admin/vpn_keys.txt{{ end }}

env_vars.name: TS_ALERT_COOLDOWN
env_vars.description: Seconds to collapse repeated identical file events (one read fires several inotify events).
